ScheduleConfig.description:
Schedule configuration from the frontend widget.
Fields accept Union[int, str] to support drag-and-drop references like
{{nodeId.values.field}} which get resolved at configuration time.

daysOfWeek.description: Days of week to run on (0=Sunday … 6=Saturday); empty = every day. Supported for seconds/minutes/hours intervals and daily schedules.
daysOfWeek.title: Daysofweek

windowStart.description: Part-of-day start as 24-hour "HH:MM" in the schedule timezone (e.g. "09:00"). Set together with windowEnd; interval frequencies only.
windowStart.title: Windowstart

windowEnd.description: Part-of-day end as 24-hour "HH:MM", inclusive — a run landing exactly on it fires (e.g. "18:00" runs the 6:00 PM tick).
windowEnd.title: Windowend

monthDayStart.description: Part-of-month start day (1-31), inclusive. Set together with monthDayEnd; a start after the end wraps around month end (25→5 = the 25th through the 5th).
monthDayStart.title: Monthdaystart

monthStart.description: Part-of-year start month (1=January … 12=December), inclusive. Set together with monthEnd; a start after the end wraps around the new year (11→2 = November through February).
monthStart.title: Monthstart

attribute.description: The attribute keys to retrieve. Pass multiple `attribute` parameters for multiple keys, or omit entirely to return all available attributes. Each key is a BuyerField value; `getBuyerSchema` lists them with what each one returns.
attribute.title: Attribute

includeFiles.description: Whether to include the source files. Set false when you only need the record.
includeFiles.title: Includefiles

includeLineItems.description: Whether to include parsed purchase-order line items. Set false to skip an extra lookup.
includeLineItems.title: Includelineitems

pageSize.description: Page size. Must be > 0 and <= 100. Prefer <= 20.
pageSize.title: Pagesize

filters.description:
Filter criteria for bridge rows. All `terms` are combined with logical AND — a row must
        satisfy every term to be included. Provide an empty `terms` list (or omit `filters`) to
        return all rows.
filters.title: Filters

sorts.description:
Sort specification for rows. For each sort term, `column` should be a bridge
        column's `columnId` UUID — call `getBridgeColumnMetadata` to look it up. The
        column's display name, `key`, or any prefixed reference is not a valid value.
        A small set of common entry-level fields (`entryId`, `entryName`, `triggeredAt`)
        is also accepted but discouraged. Fields computed per row when the Bridge is read —
        `op:added_date` ("Added to Bridge") and `bridge:entry_url` — are never sortable and
        return 400; sort by `triggeredAt` instead. The synthetic column `rowUpdatedAt` sorts by when
        the row was last updated — sort `DESC` to poll for recently-changed rows, matching the
        `updatedAt` field in the response. Sort columns that are not mapped on the server return 400.
     Omit `sorts` for the bridge's default order, the order `runRows: FirstFiveRows` takes its five rows from. A sort on an object column is refused: sort a Top Buyers bridge by its Account Scoring Score column, not the Account Score object. An enumeration column such as Fit Band sorts alphabetically, so filter it with `Any` instead. A `processBridgeRows` `limit` takes its rows from the same default order.
sorts.title: Sorts

query.description: Full-text search across the rows' searchable content
query.title: Query

buyerScope.description: Narrows the rows to those whose buyer matches this scope, on top of `filters`. Either a saved buyer list (`buyerListId`) or inline `terms` — never both. Use `listBuyerLists` to find a list id.
buyerScope.title: Buyerscope

columnIds.description: Project each row's `columns` down to these column ids. Every id must belong to this bridge. Omit to get every column `getBridgeFull` lists, including the ones hidden from the table view — send it whenever you only need a few, it is the cheapest way to keep a wide bridge inside a context window, and a link column left out is not resolved at all.
columnIds.title: Columnids

archived.description: True to list the bridge's archived rows instead of its live ones, most recently archived first unless `sorts` is sent — `rowArchivedAt` sorts by archive date; `filters`, `query`, `buyerScope` and `columnIds` apply the same way
archived.title: Archived

includeBasis.description: Whether to add each cell's `basis`: the reasoning, confidence and cited sources behind its value, for explaining why a row holds what it does. Only columns that research the web, such as web agent columns, record one. A basis can run to thousands of characters, so send it with `columnIds` set to just the columns you are explaining and a `pageSize` of 5 or fewer. Each cell lists at most its first 10 citations, each with at most 3 excerpts cut to 500 characters. Defaults to false.
includeBasis.title: Includebasis

sortField.description: Name, EntriesCount, Type, CreatedBy, CreditUsage, SharedWith, LastUpdatedByUser or CreatedAt
